name: test-pulse
description: Runs your test suite after every turn in which Claude changed source, and keeps the result above the prompt: green with the pass count, red with the first failing test. Detects bun, npm, pytest, cargo and go, or runs the command you set. Toasts on a regression and a recovery.

command.title: Test command
command.description: The command to run, split on spaces. Empty means detect it from the project: bun test, npm test, pytest, cargo test or go test.

timeoutSeconds.title: Timeout
timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for the suite before giving up on this run.

extensions.title: Source extensions
extensions.description: Comma-separated file extensions whose edits trigger a run.
